form:FormGroup.label: Private key pass phrase
form:FormGroup.helpText: The pass phrase that unlocks the private key. Leave blank if the key is not encrypted.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank if the key is not encrypted.

form:FormGroup.label: Private Key
form:FormGroup.helpText: The SSH private key in OpenSSH or PEM format, including the BEGIN and END lines. Required.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Include the BEGIN and END lines.

form:FormGroup.label: Verify Hosts
form:FormGroup.helpText: Checks the server's host key against Known Hosts before connecting. Only untick for testing, as it allows man-in-the-middle attacks. Default is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Uses Known Hosts. Default is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Known Hosts
form:FormGroup.helpText: Host keys to trust, one per line: host name, key type and key, e.g. github.com ssh-ed25519 AAAA… The host name must match the host in the repository URL exactly; hashed entries and comma-separated host lists are not supported. Used only when Verify Hosts is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: One per line: host name, key type, key.
